caption_draft:
Amazon has 16 Leadership Principles. Here are 6, in Amazon's own words.

Customer Obsession — https://www.aboutamazon.com/about-us/leadership-principles — Start with the customer, work backwards
Ownership — https://www.aboutamazon.com/about-us/leadership-principles — Leaders are owners
Learn and Be Curious — https://www.aboutamazon.com/about-us/leadership-principles — Never done learning
Bias for Action — https://www.aboutamazon.com/about-us/leadership-principles — Speed matters
Dive Deep — https://www.aboutamazon.com/about-us/leadership-principles — Stay connected to the details
Deliver Results — https://www.aboutamazon.com/about-us/leadership-principles — Right quality, in a timely fashion

Save this and write one story from your own projects for each.

#amazon #leadershipprinciples #internship #firstyear #students #engineering #notyourcollege
